name: settings-swipe-haptics-row
description: The Swipe haptics row on Settings > Inputs reaches the running sidebar at once. The row opens on the Rust core's default (crisp). Off must silence a swipe, and Smooth must tap soft detents, a plain commit, and soft settle taps. The sidebar swipes are synthetic wheel events dispatched on the rail, and a wrapped chrome.send records each sidebarSwipeHaptic, because the VM has no trackpad to feel. Off swipes to the next space and Smooth swipes back, so the fixture needs only two spaces.

actions.note: let the browser window finish first paint
Atrium MUST be frontmost or cmd+comma opens the frontmost app's own settings
the window builds, the route loads, and the core's values land a beat after the labels

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="inputs"]'); if (!item) return 'no-rail-item'; item.click(); return 'opened'; })()
(() => { const o = document.querySelector('.settings-row[data-key="swipeHaptics"] .settings-seg-option[data-choice="off"]'); if (!o) return 'no-option'; o.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: FAIL LOUDLY HERE: if the click missed the row, no save happens

actions.expression: (() => { window.__taps = []; if (!window.__tapSpy) { window.__tapSpy = true; const send = chrome.send; chrome.send = (name, args) => { if (name === 'sidebarSwipeHaptic') window.__taps.push(args && args[0]); return send.call(chrome, name, args); }; } const rail = document.querySelector('.rail'); if (!rail) return 'no-rail'; let i = 0; const t = setInterval(() => { rail.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', {deltaX: 14, bubbles: true, cancelable: true})); if (++i >= 10) clearInterval(t); }, 16); return 'driving'; })()
actions.note: 10 events of 14px, the unit tests' committing drag

actions.expression: (() => { const o = document.querySelector('.settings-row[data-key="swipeHaptics"] .settings-seg-option[data-choice="smooth"]'); if (!o) return 'no-option'; o.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { window.__taps = []; const rail = document.querySelector('.rail'); if (!rail) return 'no-rail'; let i = 0; const t = setInterval(() => { rail.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', {deltaX: -14, bubbles: true, cancelable: true})); if (++i >= 10) clearInterval(t); }, 16); return 'driving'; })()
actions.note: back to the first space, so the fixture needs only two spaces

actions.expression: (() => { const t = window.__taps || []; return `${t.slice(0, 3).join(',')}|${t.length > 3 && t.slice(3).every((s) => s === 'soft')}`; })()
actions.note: two soft detents, the plain commit, then only soft settle taps and the soft landing

assertions.label: no-unusable-argument-refusal
assertions.pattern: Atrium: the settings surface sent an object the core

assertions.desc: Off reached the running sidebar and silenced a committed swipe
Smooth reached the running sidebar: soft detents, a plain commit, soft settle taps
Cmd+Q still quits with the settings window open
